description: This file declares the interface LocationService for managing Location entities within the OpenMRS platform. It includes method signatures for CRUD operations on locations, tags, attribute types, and related functionalities like tagging, retiring, unretiring, and purging locations and their attributes.
external_methods: LocationDAO methods (not explicitly listed but implied for database interactions)

classes.name: LocationService
classes.description: Interface defining the API for managing Location entities, tags, attribute types, and related configurations within the OpenMRS healthcare system.

methods.name: setLocationDAO
methods.description: Sets the Data Access Object used for interacting with the database related to Location entities.

methods.name: saveLocation
methods.description: Creates or updates a Location object in the database, with validation and cascading behavior.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a Location by its primary key ID.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a Location by exact name.

methods.name: getDefaultLocation
methods.description: Returns the default Location for the system.

methods.name: getLocationByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Location by its UUID.

methods.name: getLocationTagByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationTag by its UUID.

methods.name: getAllLocations
methods.description: Returns all Location objects, including retired ones.

methods.name: getAllLocations
methods.description: Returns all Location objects, with option to include or exclude retired locations.

methods.name: getLocations
methods.description: Searches for locations matching a name fragment with optional parent, attributes, retired filter, start index, and length.

methods.name: getLocations
methods.description: Searches for locations by name fragment, parent location, attribute values, retired status, start index, and length.

methods.name: getLocationsByTag
methods.description: Retrieves locations associated with a specific tag.

methods.name: getLocationsHavingAllTags
methods.description: Retrieves locations that have all specified tags.

methods.name: getLocationsHavingAnyTag
methods.description: Retrieves locations that have any of the specified tags.

methods.name: retireLocation
methods.description: Retires a Location, effectively removing it from active use.

methods.name: unretireLocation
methods.description: Reactivates a previously retired Location.

methods.name: purgeLocation
methods.description: Permanently deletes a Location from the database.

methods.name: saveLocationTag
methods.description: Creates or updates a LocationTag.

methods.name: getLocationTag
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationTag by ID.

methods.name: getLocationTagByName
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationTag by its exact name.

methods.name: getAllLocationTags
methods.description: Returns all LocationTags, including retired ones.

methods.name: getAllLocationTags
methods.description: Returns location tags with option to include or exclude retired tags.

methods.name: getLocationTags
methods.description: Searches for location tags matching a search string.

methods.name: retireLocationTag
methods.description: Retires a LocationTag.

methods.name: unretireLocationTag
methods.description: Restores a retired LocationTag.

methods.name: purgeLocationTag
methods.description: Deletes a LocationTag from the database.

methods.name: getCountOfLocations
methods.description: Returns the count of locations starting with a name fragment, considering retired status.

methods.name: getRootLocations
methods.description: Returns all locations without a parent, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getPossibleAddressValues
methods.description: Returns potential address values for a specified address field; not implemented in core.

methods.name: getAddressTemplate
methods.description: Returns the XML template for addresses.

methods.name: saveAddressTemplate
methods.description: Saves a new address template to global properties.

methods.name: getAllLocationAttributeTypes
methods.description: Returns all location attribute types, including retired ones.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationAttributeType by ID.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: saveLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Creates or updates a LocationAttributeType.

methods.name: retireLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Retires a LocationAttributeType.

methods.name: unretireLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Restores a retired LocationAttributeType.

methods.name: purgeLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Permanently deletes a LocationAttributeType.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationAttribute by its UUID.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationAttributeType by its name.
